exercises.question: Which sentence describes a process using a connector? [¿Cuál describe un proceso usando un conector?]
options: Mediante este sistema, se reduce el consumo de energía. [By means of this system, energy consumption is reduced.]
El sistema existe. [The system exists.]
El consumo fue ayer. [The consumption was yesterday.]

exercises.sentence: El primer __ consiste en preparar el material. (paso) [The first step consists of preparing the material.]

exercises.english: By means of this system, energy consumption is reduced.

sentences: Primero se prepara el material. [First the material is prepared.]
Después se corta. [Then it is cut.]
Por último, se comprueba el resultado. [Lastly, the result is checked.]

exercises.question: Which expression means «by means of»? [¿Qué expresión significa «mediante»?]
options: mediante [by means of]
por último [lastly]
paso [step]

exercises.sentence: __, se comprueba que todo funciona correctamente. (por último) [Lastly, it is checked that everything works correctly.]

exercises.english: Then each piece is checked to avoid errors.

exercises.sentence: Mediante este sistema, se reduce el consumo de energía.
options: By means of this system, energy consumption is reduced.
This system increases energy consumption.
The system was removed.

exercises.sentence: Por último, se comprueba que todo funciona correctamente.
options: Lastly, it is checked that everything works correctly.
First, everything is removed.
Nothing is checked.

exercises.sentence: Después se revisa cada pieza para evitar errores.
Primero se prepara el material y después se corta.
options: First the material is prepared and then it is cut.
The material is cut before it is prepared.
The material is never cut.
El primer paso consiste en preparar el material. [The first step consists of preparing the material.]
El primer paso termina ayer. [The first step finishes yesterday.]
El paso es una máquina. [The step is a machine.]
Mediante este sistema. [By means of this system.]
Por último, ayer. [Lastly, yesterday.]

template.prompt: Explain three stages using sequencing and process connectors.
template.answer: Primero se prepara el material, después se revisa y por último se comprueba el resultado.

template.prompt: Explain how something is achieved using mediante.
template.answer: Mediante este sistema, se reduce el consumo de energía.
